supporting_observations.claim: The domain account adm_temp was created at 13:45:13 UTC by ian.doyle, rather than at the alert's approximate 13:42 time. The account name does not match the documented temporary-account naming convention v.<name>.

Immediately after creation, adm_temp was added to the Administrators group. This conflicts with the documented practice that temporary accounts never receive administrator rights and supports a malicious disposition of the alerted account activity.

Before the account was created, ian.doyle logged on interactively to WS-MFISCHER-01 via RDP from 192.0.2.199. The inventory says remote administration is only performed from WS-IDOYLE-01 and there is no VPN; this session is inconsistent with that context.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records do not show the source host or IP for the domain account creation and group-membership change.
The alert's approximate creation time differs from the recorded account creation time of 13:45:13 UTC.
The evidence does not include change approval or confirmation from ian.doyle.
claims_not_established: Whether ian.doyle intentionally performed these changes or the account or session was compromised.
Whether adm_temp was subsequently used, what its password was, or whether it accessed systems or data.
Whether the suspicious scheduled task on WS-MFISCHER-01 was part of the same activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the account creation and administrator-group change with ian.doyle and the change records; preserve the relevant domain-controller audit logs.
Investigate the RDP session and authenticate its source and authorization, including the corresponding logs on WS-MFISCHER-01.
Review adm_temp's subsequent logons, group membership, password changes, and access to domain resources; disable or contain the account pending verification.
unrelated_findings: A scheduled task named HealthCheck was registered on WS-MFISCHER-01 under ian.doyle with hidden PowerShell execution and an encoded command that fetches a script from http://192.0.2.199/a.ps1. Investigate separately; it is not needed to determine the account-creation alert. (T257-00102)
